caption:
No Oil Paneer Tikka Sliders
low effort | 30 minute recipe 

Nutrition: 
C: 49 | F: 26 | P: 23
Calories: 530  per serve ( for 2 sliders) 
Serves 2 (4 sliders total)

Ingredients
Tikka Marinade - marinate paneer for 30 minutes minimum
200 grams paneer, cut into 8 pieces
2 tbsp thick curd / greek yogurt
1 tbsp RCP 
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp haldi
1 tsp Garam masala
1 tsp jeera powder 
1 tsp chaat masala
Salt to taste
1 tbsp gg paste 

sauce: 
2 tbsp Greek yogurt
1 tbsp green chutney
1 tsp chaat masala 

Assembly
Chopped lettuce
Pickled onions 
Pav or slider buns 

Method
Make the marinade with all ingredients and add paneer
Set aside for 30 minutes or overnight as per your time available
Cook the paneer on a pan till it’s ready 
Toast the pav on a pan 
Layer the sliders and enjoy
